turns.question: What was our real revenue in the first ten days of October 2026?
turns.answer: "Real revenue" could mean two things here, so both figures for 1 to 10 October 2026 (10 days): revenue (gross, non-cancelled orders) was EUR 2,137.34, and net revenue (revenue minus partner returns) was EUR 2,047.59. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
